Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: CRED's card-in-hand reveal - a hand holding the white credit card slides in from the left edge, tilts to its resting angle, and the feature row fades in beneath it.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
CRED card page, white: "transparent by design." headline with subcopy, a feature row under the hero (icons + labels), and a black "Get your card" button. The hero: a photoreal hand holding the white card with its red accent block, tilted about -12 degrees.

## Motion spec
Pattern: handheld card slide-in with a rotational settle.
- The hand+card enters from off-screen left (translateX -60% -> 0, rotateZ -18 -> -12 degrees, spring ~260/13) - a placing gesture, not a throw.
- On landing there's a small counter-rotation (rotateZ -12 -> -10 -> -12, 250ms) like the hand adjusting its grip.
- The card catches a soft shadow beneath it that fades in over 300ms after the settle.
- The feature row fades up beneath the card (translateY 10 -> 0, 250ms) only after the card rests.
- Idle: the hand holds nearly still with a barely-there sway (rotateZ +/-0.5 degrees, 4s).

## Calibration
- The hand is photographic, not illustrated - motion must be slow and weighty to match.
- The card's red block is the only saturated element; keep it tack-sharp through the rotation.

## Reduced motion
Hand+card fades in at rest position (300ms); feature row follows (200ms).

## Don't miss
- Fingers wrap the card's edges - the card is held, not floating over a palm.
- The entry happens once per page visit; scrolling away and back does not replay it.
